description: Replicate unchanged beta=0 U five-branch relation with model seeds 04/05/06; compare exact original same-seed Tri-SIG-TIME E50 with newly computed matching seven-scene DURA-LU predictions.
authorization: User requests Tri-SIG-TIME-based multi-branch SSL research, three paired seeds, practical seven scenes and GPU 0-4 on N607.

code.environment: N607 existing Phase1 Python; FP32 TF32 off; 2 CPU threads

data.contract_ref: existing unchanged VALIDATED_ONCE Main split source/received IQ handles
data.physical_ids_ref: Main split source role index and cross_rx/cross_both manifests

roles.U_s: 56700 source IQ with TX labels hidden

data.leo_config_ref: clean plus six practical scenes only; no leo_weak

permissions.claim_scope: Phase1 terrestrial proxy; direct recognition; no future-date or in-orbit claim

checkpoint.initialization: same-seed Tri-SIG-TIME source-only scratch E20; continue E10+E20
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: same F0 source contract; no target or U truth use
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final E50, no target feedback

execution.gpu_policy: All N607 GPUs 0-7 authorized; 5,6,7 preferred, at most two observed or pending processes/card; preserve other owners
execution.launch_command: python -m experiments.pamf_tri_u_extra.publish --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
execution.stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch; retain healthy workers and output; no target-driven decisions

expected_artifacts: three fixed E50 U relation candidates
original Tri E50 04/05/06 baseline prediction (new DURA readout)
six complete seven-scene predictions before independent truth-last scoring
three-seed matched per-scene, TX/RX/day and same-packet comparison

notes: Beta=0 recipe was identified after exposure to Main split results for seeds 01/02/03; these new model seeds reduce seed overfitting but do not make the existing physical test set blind.
The candidate recipe and E50 freeze are fixed before these additional seed predictions; no target-driven checkpoint selection or rerun.

Original Tri seed 04/05/06 source E20 and E50 are reused. Prior paper completion did not contain these three matching DURA readouts; original-model predictions are newly computed with the frozen DURA caches.
Ordinary PL matching 04/05/06 is not available in this release; comparison against PL remains limited to previously matched seeds 01/02/03.
Only clean and six practical scenes; DURA-LU primary, raw and DURA-L secondary; cross_rx plus cross_both main and cross_date diagnostic.
